runner: Gemini 3.7 Flash High via Antigravity IDE
notes: Single-shot run in Antigravity IDE. Full-featured, self-contained PvZ clone with zero external asset dependencies. Features include: Title screen, Main Menu, Level-based Adventure mode, Endless Survival mode, Plant Almanac encyclopedia, Persistent Leaderboards (localStorage), Interactive Audio/FX synthesizer (Web Audio API). In-game systems: 5-lane lawn grid, lawnmowers as last line of defense, 6 distinct plants (Sunflower, Peashooter, Snow Pea, Wall-nut with progressive damage states, Cherry Bomb with screen shake, Potato Mine with arming sequence), shovel tool, 4 zombie types (Regular, Conehead, Buckethead, Fast Runner), particle splats, floating text, and wave announcements.
